name: Conditional same-policy Deny narrows a rule edge (may-block, not blocked)
note: Allow iam:PutUserPolicy with an unconditional grant, but a same-policy Deny of the same action carries a Condition (MFA absent). A conditional Deny may not fire, so it must NOT be reported as a hard block; graph.js downgrades the can-modify(policy:self) edge to conditionally-reachable instead of blocked-by-deny.
